stories.label: Iran opens Hormuz for friendly nations, creates two-tier shipping regime
stories.summary: Iran permits Hormuz passage for China, Russia, India, Iraq, Pakistan. Non-hostile vessels must coordinate with Iranian authorities. Transforms blockade into geopolitical sorting mechanism.

stories.label: US deploys Marines + 82nd Airborne, Kharg Island seizure scenario live
stories.summary: Pentagon ordered two Marine Expeditionary Units plus 1,000 82nd Airborne to Gulf. Three scenarios: seize Kharg Island, capture nuclear material, or break Hormuz. Mattis: unconditional surrender was delusional.

stories.label: Iran formally rejects 15-point US ceasefire, issues 5 counter-demands
stories.summary: Iran opens Hormuz for 'friendly nations' (China, Russia, India, Iraq, Pakistan) while rejecting US ceasefire. Creates two-tier shipping regime. FM Araghchi: 'no negotiations underway.'

stories.label: UNHRC approves emergency debate on Minab school massacre (168 girls killed)
stories.summary: UNHRC approved by consensus emergency debate on Feb 28 Tomahawk strike that killed 168 girls at Minab school. Co-sponsored by China and Cuba. Debate scheduled March 27.

stories.label: Iran warns of enemy island occupation attempt, threatens regional infrastructure
stories.summary: Ghalibaf: enemies preparing to occupy Iranian island with regional country support. Threatened to target entire regions vital infrastructure.

stories.label: Iran parliament drafting Hormuz toll law to monetize strait passage
stories.summary: Iranian parliament drafting bill to charge tolls for Hormuz passage, formalizing sovereignty and creating revenue. Brent crude at 114/barrel.

stories.label: Iran fires cruise missiles at USS Abraham Lincoln carrier group
stories.summary: Iran claims Qader anti-ship cruise missiles forced USS Lincoln to reposition. No US confirmation. Comes as 82nd Airborne deploys 1,000+ troops.

stories.label: Trump-Xi summit rescheduled to May 14-15, trade and Iran war on agenda
stories.summary: Summit delayed from March to May 14-15 because of Iran war. Trade tariffs (Section 301 replacing IEEPA after SCOTUS), Hormuz closure, and China's 1.38M barrels/day Iranian crude loss on agenda.

stories.label: Zelenskyy: US conditions security guarantees on Ukraine giving up Donbas
stories.summary: Zelenskyy tells Reuters the US will only finalize security guarantees once Ukraine withdraws from Donbas. Russia betting US will lose interest. Iran war consuming US diplomatic bandwidth.

stories.label: EU-Mercosur trade deal provisionally applied from May 1
stories.summary: EU enacts Mercosur deal provisionally May 1, sidestepping parliament and pending ECJ ruling. 700M people, 30% GDP. France/Poland opposed but lost.

stories.label: No Kings protests March 28: 3,000+ events across all 50 US states
stories.summary: Largest US protest movement: 3,000+ events every congressional district. Previous turnouts 5M and 7M. Coalition of unions, ACLU, teachers, nurses against Trump administration.

stories.label: Anonymous Polymarket trader profits ~$1M from suspiciously timed Iran war bets
stories.summary: Anonymous trader won nearly $1M on Polymarket with bets placed before major Iran strike announcements. Sen. Murphy flagged suspicious timing. Knesset also advances death penalty bill for Palestinians.

stories.label: Google estimates quantum computers will break encryption by 2029
stories.summary: Google revised Q Day estimate to 2029. Banks, governments, and cryptocurrencies have ~3 years to migrate to post-quantum cryptography.

stories.label: Disney kills $1B OpenAI Sora deal after 3 months, AI slop rejected
stories.summary: Disney pulled $1B OpenAI investment and killed Sora integration after 3 months. Sora shut down entirely. Paramount-WB merger premised on AI savings looks shakier.

stories.label: Hezbollah holds off Israeli ground advance at Khiam and Taybeh
stories.summary: 2-week Israeli ground invasion hasn't secured strategic Khiam hilltop. Hezbollah uses guerrilla 'kill pockets' to prevent armor from entering town center.

stories.label: Bhutan dumps 152M bitcoin in 2026, Gelephu Mindfulness City pledge broken
stories.summary: Bhutan sold 152M BTC in 2026 via QCP Capital. Holdings down 66% from 13,000 to 4,453 BTC. 10,000 BTC Gelephu pledge now impossible.

stories.label: Bellingcat: 9 Facebook groups trade protected species in Indonesia, one broker
stories.summary: Bellingcat+Mongabay: 9 Facebook groups (70K+ members) trade endangered species in Indonesia using coded language. All traced to single Jakarta broker. Active 5+ years despite Meta ban.

stories.label: StreamEast piracy ring busted in Egypt: 1.6B visits/year from one apartment
stories.summary: Two men in Sheikh Zayed, Giza ran worlds largest pirated sports streaming network. 1.6B visits/year. LeBron caught watching it courtside. 22 officers deployed for raid.

stories.label: Israel locks down prisons during Iran war, bars lawyer visits to Palestinian detainees
stories.summary: Israel locked down all prisons at start of Iran war. Palestinian detainees cut off from legal representation. +972 reports from lawyer unable to reach her client.

stories.label: Gulf war bombing contaminating air, soil, water for decades
stories.summary: SciDev.Net: bombing oil facilities in the Gulf contaminating air, soil, and water systems. Environmental damage will persist for decades after fighting ends.

stories.label: Bellingcat tracks same Border Patrol agents using force across multiple US cities
stories.summary: Bellingcat analyzed 85 hours of footage, tracked same masked agents from Bakersfield to Chicago. Federal judge: use of force "shocks the conscience."

stories.label: India files criminal charges against X Corp for AI deepfake during elections
stories.summary: Kerala Police filed FIR against X Corp for hosting AI deepfake targeting PM Modi and Election Commission during elections. First prosecution of platform itself for AI-generated political disinformation.

stories.label: US sends 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran; Tehran's military rejects talks
stories.summary: US sends 15-point ceasefire via Pakistan including nuclear dismantlement and Hormuz reopening. 82nd Airborne deploying 1,000+ troops simultaneously.

stories.label: Spain PM calls Iran war absolute disaster, refuses US base access
stories.summary: Sanchez tells parliament Iran war is far worse than Iraq 2003. Refuses US base access despite Trump trade threats.

stories.label: Israeli settlers expanding into West Bank Areas B and A, erasing Oslo lines
stories.summary: +972 joint investigation: settlers expanding beyond Area C into PA-jurisdiction zones. De facto annexation without declaration.

stories.label: Meta loses child safety trial: $375M verdict, Operation MetaPhile evidence
stories.summary: NM jury awards 375M. Zuckerberg testified harms inevitable. Two more trials pending. LA jury also finds Meta+Google liable for $3M in separate addiction case.

stories.label: Judge signals Anthropic may win injunction against Pentagon supply chain risk label
stories.summary: Judge Lin: Pentagon designation looks like attempt to cripple Anthropic. 69% Americans want more AI regulation.

stories.label: Accidentally released Smith memo reveals Trump kept docs tied to business interests
stories.summary: Jack Smith memo (accidentally released by DOJ) shows Trump kept documents 'only 6 people had access to,' pertinent to business interests. Aide uploaded scans to cloud. Wiles witnessed plane incident.

stories.label: South Africa police commissioner Masemola faces criminal charges in R360M tender
stories.summary: National Commissioner Masemola served court notice for April 21. Connected to R360M Medicare 24 tender via 'Cat' Matlala. 12 officers arrested. Third SA police boss to face charges. Factional war inside SAPS between rival narratives.

stories.label: WMO: Earth's energy imbalance highest in 65 years, 11 hottest years in a row
stories.summary: State of Global Climate 2025: first time energy imbalance included. Highest in 65 years. 90%+ excess heat absorbed by oceans (record 2025). Guterres: 'Every indicator flashing red.'
